18.14.15  z_0/4 | -\frac{i}{2}(\alpha+\sqrt{2\alpha}) | \alpha(\sqrt\alpha+\sqrt2)e^{i\pi/4} | -- (blank in print) | \dfrac{e^{\pi/64}(2^{1/32})}{\alpha^{1/4}(\sqrt\alpha+\sqrt2)^{1/4}}e^{i\pi/4}
18.14.16  z_0/2 | -i/2 | e^{i\pi/4} | \big[\frac{\pi}{4\omega\sqrt2}+\frac12\big]e^{-i\pi/4} | e^{\pi/16}(2^{1/8})e^{i\pi/4}
18.14.17  2z_0/3 | -\frac{i}{2}\sqrt{\sec30^\circ-1} | \dfrac{e^{i\pi/4}\sqrt[4]{2\sqrt3-3}}{\sqrt3} | \dfrac{2\eta_2}{3}+\Big[\dfrac{\wp(2z_0/3)}{3}\Big]^{1/2} | \dfrac{e^{\pi/9}e^{i\pi/4}(3^{1/6})}{\sqrt[12]{2\sqrt3-3}}
18.14.18  3z_0/4 | -\frac{i}{2}(\alpha-\sqrt{2\alpha}) | \alpha(\sqrt\alpha-\sqrt2)e^{i\pi/4} | -- (blank in print) | \dfrac{e^{9\pi/64}(2^{1/32})}{\alpha^{1/4}(\sqrt\alpha-\sqrt2)^{1/4}}e^{i\pi/4}
\alpha=1+\sqrt2
Duplication Formulas
18.14.19  \wp(2z)=[\wp^2(z)+\frac14]^2/\{\wp(z)[4\wp^2(z)-1]\}
18.14.20  \wp'(2z)=(\beta+1)(\beta^2-6\beta+1)/[32\wp'^3(z)],\ \ \beta=4\wp^2(z)
18.14.21  \zeta(2z)=2\zeta(z)+\dfrac{6\wp^2(z)-\frac12}{2\wp'(z)}
18.14.22  \sigma(2z)=-\wp'(z)\sigma^4(z)
Bisection Formulas (0<x<2\omega)
18.14.23  \wp\Big(\dfrac{x}{2}\Big)=[\wp^{1/2}(x)+\{\wp(x)+\tfrac12\}^{1/2}][\wp^{1/2}(x)\pm\{\wp(x)-\tfrac12\}^{1/2}]\qquad[\text{Use }+\text{ on }0<x\le\omega,\ -\text{ on }\omega\le x<2\omega]
18.14.24  \tfrac12\wp'\Big(\dfrac{x}{2}\Big)=\wp'(x)\mp[2\wp(x)+\tfrac12]\sqrt{\wp(x)-\tfrac12}-[2\wp(x)-\tfrac12]\sqrt{\wp(x)+\tfrac12}-2\wp^{3/2}(x)\ \text{(See [18.13].)}\qquad[\text{Use }-\text{ on }0<x\le\omega,\ +\text{ on }\omega\le x<2\omega]
Complex Multiplication
18.14.25  \wp(iz)=-\wp(\dot z)
18.14.26  \wp'(iz)=i\wp'(z)
18.14.27  \zeta(iz)=-i\zeta(z)
18.14.28  \sigma(iz)=i\sigma(z)
The above equations could be used as follows, e.g.: If z were real, iz would be purely imaginary.
Conformal Maps
Lemniscatic Case
Map: f(z)=u+iv
\wp(z)
Near zero:  \wp(z)=\dfrac{1}{z^2}+\epsilon_1
\wp(z)=\dfrac{1}{z^2}+\dfrac{z^2}{20}+\epsilon_2,\ |z|<1
Near z_0:  \wp(z)=\dfrac{-(z-z_0)^2}{4}+\epsilon_3,\ |z-z_0|<\sqrt2
\wp(z)=\dfrac{-(z-z_0)^2}{4}+\dfrac{(z-z_0)^6}{80}+\epsilon_4
Error bounds printed beside the figure: |\epsilon_1|\le.05,\ |\epsilon_2|\le.0009,\ |\epsilon_3|\le.1,\ |\epsilon_4|\le.01
[Figure, not fully transcribed: a conformal-map plot of f(z)=u+iv showing the image under \wp(z) of a right-triangle region 0\le x\le1.8, 0\le y\le1.0 in the z-plane (small inset diagram, axes x/y, labelled z_0 at the triangle's right-angle corner) mapped to a curved (u,v)-plane grid of radial/angular contour lines labelled with real values 0.7-1.8 and imaginary-axis labels .1i-.9i, spanning roughly u\in[0,1.4], v\in[-1.0,0].]

Mixed-content page: a 4-row table of closed-form values at z_0/4, z_0/2, 2z_0/3, 3z_0/4 (the \zeta column is genuinely blank in print for the z_0/4 and 3z_0/4 rows -- not an omission on our part), a duplication/bisection/complex-multiplication formula list (18.14.19-28), and a conformal-map figure (Lemniscatic Case) that is a plotted grid, not formula text -- described qualitatively rather than digitized, since it carries no extractable formula IDs.
